description: Waze Minimize Search Bar for Waze Mod 5.24.5.0

patches.name: Waze Minimize Search Bar
patches.description: Reduce the collapsed search sheet to a 24 dp handle; swipe up to expand it.

release_notes:
Waze Minimize Search Bar for Waze Mod 5.24.5.0 (`com.chisadin.wazemod`).

This version changes the collapsed search-sheet height when Waze recalculates its anchors. The patch has been applied to the target APK and its bytecode inspected, but its appearance and gesture behavior still need a phone test.
